title: A State-transition Framework to Answer Complex Questions over Knowledge Base
abstract: Although natural language question answering over knowledge graphs have been studied in the literature, existing methods have some limitations in answering complex questions.To address that, in this paper, we propose a State Transition-based approach to translate a complex natural language question N to a semantic query graph (SQG) Q S , which is used to match the underlying knowledge graph to find the answers to question N .In order to generate Q S , we propose four primitive operations (expand, fold, connect and merge) and a learning-based state transition approach.Extensive experiments on several benchmarks (such as QALD, WebQuestions and ComplexQuestions) with two knowledge bases (DBpedia and Freebase) confirm the superiority of our approach compared with stateof-the-arts.
